csv_project_name: Design for Community Solar - Port of Ridgefield
csv_scope_of_work: The purpose of this specification is to obtain a photovoltaic (PV) system installer (CONTRACTOR) to design, supply and install a PV system on the rooftop of a building at the Port of Ridgefield at 5645 S 11th St, Ridgefield, WA 98642. This project is part of the Clark Public Utilities Community Solar at the Port of Ridgefield. The value of the electricity generated will directly fund the Operation Warm Heart low-income energy assistance fund. The aggregate PV DC nameplate capacity under this bid shall be 180 kW; the PV array will be installed on one building at the Port of Ridgefield Wisdom Ridge Business Park. This bid document outlines the total available square feet on the building. The building is walkable and can handle normal foot traffic.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering
